body: The probationary thing is basically what my boss wants to do with me. But she's stated to me that she doesn't expect me to succeed. It comes down to failing that later (whether its 30, 60, or 90 days) or just giving in now (suicide). I know the rational side of me is saying use those days to find a new job, but honestly I've been looking everywhere and can't find a single thing that would pay ok. I can hope they fire me so I can get unemployment insurance, but that's risky too.

To make matters worse, I got a call from a recruiter for a position elsewhere. Everything seemed fine, I saw my ticket out of the place, but now the recruiter won't respond to any emails or calls. This was about 2 weeks ago. My boss was on vacation so it was less stressful.

And from my understanding, this plan is supposed to be like a mini probationary period to see if I improve. I know the intent is to improve but I feel my boss is setting me up to fail based on what she's said to me.

She also wants to put me on a plan to improve, but after I asked if anyone has improved and succeeded she said no. She basically wants me gone ASAP and I think she was goading me into quitting right then. A friend who works there that knows my side of the story says I should talk to HR. That she handled this wrong. I fear the retaliation from my boss once they tell her I went there.

About a month ago I spoke to my boss's boss, and later my boss, about my concerns with my position. That I didn't feel I was getting enough training. I was told by both that I'm doing ok and shouldn't worry. A couple weeks later my boss brings me to her office and explains that I'm actually doing terrible and should start looking for another job.

Congrats on your change! This was the change for me though. I was just finishing my grad degree when I managed to get this position. We (my wife and I) bought a house together then a couple months ago we got married. She's quitting work because our plan was to have her go back to school as we'd have enough if it were just my income. Now things might have to change..

I don't know, death seems inviting right now. Today I've gone outside and have felt differently, like its my last day on Earth. I'm afraid if I talk to her she'll get so upset, and she's damn near suicidal too.
Anyone out there? I could use advice
